Thanks — I'd love to help you build this. Before we get into any screens or features, I want to make sure I understand what you're really after, so we build the right thing.

Let me start with the "why":

**When this bookmark app is finished and working well, what would be different from how you handle bookmarks today?** For example — is the pain right now that bookmarks get lost, that you can't find them again later, that they're scattered across devices or browsers, or something else entirely?

And a related one: **who is this for — just you, or a group of people who'd share it?**

Once I understand the real goal behind it, we'll walk through actual working screens together, one step at a time, so you can react to something concrete rather than just talk in the abstract.
